hook: Sixteen everyday classroom phrases on picture cards. Each phrase lights up word by word, then the class says it together on a 3-2-1 count. Then guess the phrase from the picture and decide what to say in short situations.
outcome: Use everyday classroom phrases to ask for help, state needs and talk with friends
sources: Illustrations drawn with FLUX.1-schnell (Apache 2.0) on a local computer, edited for Curio Class
